reasoning_content:
The admin redirect is a 302. Let me check where /admin redirects. The guide says if fresh install, redirect to bootstrap wizard. Let me follow the redirect.

Note the redirected location header not shown (cut off). Let's get location.

action.command: curl -s -D - -o /dev/null http://localhost:8080/admin | grep -i location; echo "=== follow ==="; curl -s -L http://localhost:8080/admin | head -30

tool_call.name: terminal
